title: ipnet v2 serde feature is stable but major bump would silently break
description: Cargo.toml:35: ipnet = { version = '2', features = ['serde'] }. The 'serde' feature name has been stable across all of ipnet 2.x (confirmed at 2.12.0). The version = '2' bound correctly prevents a breaking v3 bump from being auto-adopted. No action needed now, but note for future: if ipnet 3.x ships and the serde feature is renamed (ipnet history shows this is unlikely but possible), the build will fail loudly rather than silently. This is lower risk than most crate upgrades because the failure mode is a compile error, not silent misbehavior. Low-priority awareness item only.
